CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_workspace_members(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not baya_private.owns_workspace(p_workspace_id) then raise exception 'unauthorized' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('profileId',p.profile_id,'displayName',p.display_name,'active',m.is_active) order by m.joined_at,m.membership_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 from public.workspace_memberships m join public.profiles p on p.profile_id=m.learner_profile_id where m.workspace_id=p_workspace_id);
end $function$

functions.name: own_mentor
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.own_mentor()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select m.mentor_profile_id from public.mentor_profiles m join public.profiles p on p.profile_id=m.profile_id
 join auth.users u on u.id=p.auth_user_id
 where p.auth_user_id=(select auth.uid()) and p.role='mentor' and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
$function$

functions.name: owns_workspace

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.owns_workspace(w uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.workspaces where workspace_id=w and mentor_profile_id=baya_private.own_mentor())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.can_read_workspace(w uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select baya_private.owns_workspace(w) or exists(select 1 from public.workspace_memberships where workspace_id=w and learner_profile_id=baya_private.own_profile() and is_active)
$function$

functions.name: create_auth_profile
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.create_auth_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare p uuid; learner boolean := coalesce(new.is_anonymous,false) or new.raw_user_meta_data->>'account_type'='learner';
begin
 insert into public.profiles(auth_user_id,display_name,role)
 values(new.id,left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name'),''),case when learner then 'Learner' else 'Mentor' end),100),case when learner then 'learner' else 'mentor' end)
 returning profile_id into p;
 if not coalesce(learner,false) then insert into public.mentor_profiles(profile_id) values(p); end if;
 return new;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.own_profile()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.profile_id from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.auth_user_id
 where p.auth_user_id=(select auth.uid()) and (u.email_confirmed_at is not null or coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.can_read_learner(p uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p=baya_private.own_profile() or exists(select 1 from public.workspace_memberships m join public.workspaces w using(workspace_id)
 where m.learner_profile_id=p and m.is_active and w.status='active' and w.mentor_profile_id=baya_private.own_mentor())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION baya_private.progress_summary(p uuid, synced timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with topics as (
 select a.activity_id,a.title,l.stage_number,a.sequence_no,done.attempted_at
 from public.activities a join public.lessons l using(lesson_id) join public.content_versions v using(content_version_id)
 left join public.activity_attempts done on done.activity_id=a.activity_id and done.learner_profile_id=p and done.result_status='completed'
 where v.version_label='version-baya-modules-1-to-3-v1'
 order by l.stage_number,a.sequence_no
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('profileId',p,'displayName',(select display_name from public.profiles where profile_id=p),
 'lastSyncedAt',synced,'completedTopics',count(attempted_at),'totalTopics',count(*),
 'percentage',case when synced is null then null else round(100.0*count(attempted_at)/nullif(count(*),0)) end,
 'currentTopic',case when synced is null then 'Not synchronized yet' else coalesce((select title from topics where attempted_at is null order by stage_number,sequence_no limit 1),'All topics completed') end,
 'stage',coalesce((select stage_number from topics where attempted_at is null order by stage_number,sequence_no limit 1),3),'totalStages',3)
 from topics
$function$
